summary: This 8-K filing reports the results of NXP Semiconductors N.V.'s 2026 annual general meeting of shareholders held on June 10, 2026. The filing presents vote outcomes on routine agenda items, including adoption of 2025 statutory annual accounts, discharge of board members, re-appointment of directors (one executive and nine non-executive), and standard authorizations to issue shares, restrict pre-emption rights, repurchase shares, and cancel shares. There are no special-situation events such as a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or strategic review. The meeting results reflect ordinary governance procedures with no unusual shareholder opposition or other triggering events. This is a routine current report of shareholder votes, not a special situation.
